snippet.title: I wasted 2 YEARS for this
snippet.description:
This took me 5 days to render all thanks to Adobe. I am sure I can't get 1000 subs by the end of this month that's why I casually said I was gonna make a face reveal video(like it's ever gonna happen). So if you wanna see me suffer just subscribe also if I get 100 likes before 19th may I will make a tutorial(finally got that right) on how you can make your own custom level editor. Also make sure to check out @RedMemesALot   and @SomeRandomDevWasTaken  they have helped me a lot.
